title: Proof-Carrying Systems — Verified High-Assurance Security Core
description: AI-generated, independently AXLE-verified, axiom-clean proofs of seL4-class security properties (integrity, confidentiality, separation, capability confinement, refinement) plus a crypto-verification layer (MAC, AEAD, Merkle, constant-time) and the Proof-Carrying Apps software-security layer. Every claim binds to a formally verified theorem; each renders its own certificate. Prepared as the demonstrator for a Galois briefing.

claims.claim: Capstone — whole-kernel security: from a policy-conformant start, EVERY reachable state of the unified capability-microkernel model preserves the full composite policy (integrity AND memory separation AND IPC confinement), across arbitrarily many operations in any interleaving.
Integrity (authority confinement): from a policy-conformant start, every reachable state's capabilities stay within policy — no operation manufactures unauthorized authority.
Take-grant confinement: reachable authority never exceeds the take-grant closure of the initial protection graph (the general form of kernel integrity).
Confidentiality (noninterference) over an arbitrary security lattice: a domain's observation depends only on the domains cleared to influence it; secrets leak zero information downward.
Memory separation: the contents of an address are unchanged unless an authorized write targets it; disjoint-authority subjects are mutually invisible.
IPC confinement: every message delivered to a subject is explained by an authorized send on an endpoint both parties hold capabilities for — no unmediated channel.
Refinement: an abstract safety property is transported through a forward-simulation refinement to a structurally-different concrete layer — the seL4 methodology, mechanized.
Scheduler fairness: the round-robin dispatcher is starvation-free — every ready thread is dispatched within one queue cycle; and a blocked thread is never scheduled.

Deadlock-freedom (liveness): a well-matched synchronous-IPC system never wedges — every rendezvous strictly reduces the blocked count, so the system provably drains to quiescence; a lone thread awaiting an external partner is honest waiting, not deadlock.

Capability revocation: revoking a capability reclaims all authority derived from it — after revoke, no live capability is a descendant in the derivation tree (complete), while unrelated capabilities are untouched (surgical).
Availability (CIA triad complete): a subject with headroom can always allocate up to its reserved quota, provably independent of every other subject's activity — no cross-subject denial of service.

Refinement composes: a safety property proved on the abstract spec is transported across a 3-level chain (abstract capability-set ⊒ intermediate log ⊒ concrete bitmap) to secure the implementation — the seL4 abstract⊒executable⊒C architecture, mechanized.

Multi-prover: three security properties (OTP involution, default-deny, unauthorized-write frame) are cross-verified by BOTH Z3 (SMT) and Lean/AXLE on identical statements — 'verified' is not one-prover-deep.

Controlled declassification (delimited release): with a sanctioned downgrade channel releasing f(high), states agreeing on public data AND on f(high) stay indistinguishable to Low forever — Low learns exactly f(high) and nothing more; pure noninterference is the no-declassify special case.
MAC: a message has a unique valid tag under a key, so verification accepts only the authentic tag (blind guessing is the only structure-respecting attack).
AEAD: a tampered ciphertext is rejected (decryption fails closed) whenever the MAC distinguishes it from the authentic one.
Merkle tamper-evidence: altering a leaf value provably changes the computed root along the same proof path — you cannot swap committed data without breaking the proof.
Constant-time: for data-oblivious programs the observable trace (branch outcomes + accessed addresses) is provably independent of secret inputs — no timing/cache side channel.
Write integrity (Proof-Carrying Apps): a foreign-tenant write is prevented — the member check blocks cross-tenant mutation.
Certificate soundness (Proof-Carrying Apps): ed25519 verification is sound with respect to the signing equation.
